tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide for setting up Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga to be played in Archipelago.
tutorials.text:
# Setup Guide for Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga in Archipelago

## Required Software
- PC Release of Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga
  - Both the Steam version and GOG version are supported.
  - The retail PC release is not expected to work currently, unless it is identical to the GOG version.
- Archipelago
- Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga apworld

## Optional Software
- [Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga Archipelago Tracker](https://github.com/Mysteryem/TCS_AP_PopTracker/releases/latest), 
for use with [PopTracker](https://github.com/black-sliver/PopTracker/releases)
- [Universal Tracker](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1367270230635839539) for Archipelago (links to the
Universal Tracker channel in the Archipelago discord server). Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga Archipelago supports
yamlless Universal Tracker tracking. The Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga Client will embed Universal Tracker within
the client when Universal Tracker is installed.
- [DxWnd](https://sourceforge.net/projects/dxwnd/) for alternate or more control over playing in a window instead of using `/toggle_windowed` in the client
  - DxWnd works better with the GOG version of the game because the Steam version has SteamStub DRM applied
  - Only download DxWnd from the linked *sourceforge.net* site, dxwnd.org is an **impersonation** and could serve **malware**
  - In DxWnd, use `File`>`Import`, and then open the `Lego Star Wars - The Complete Saga` file in the `DxWnd\exports`
folder. After importing, right click and `Modify`, then adjust the `Path` to your `LEGOStarWarsSaga.exe` and adjust the
window size to your liking (`W` and `H` in `Main`>`Position`>`Window initial position & size`)
  - In-game, change the game's resolution to match the window size (optional, but recommended) 
  - Additional steps for Steam version:
    - The Steam version can sometimes crash when starting when run through Dxwnd, but it is stable once it has managed
to start. You should at least sometimes get to the TTGames logo screen before crashing if everything is set up
correctly. Crashes can occur as late as the title screen.
    - If Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga is installed on a separate drive to Steam, and you get
`Application load error 5:0000065434` when starting the game through DxWnd, copy your `Steam.exe` file into the same
directory as your `LEGOStarWarsSaga.exe`.

## Apworld Installation Instructions

Install the Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga apworld by either
- double-clicking on the .apworld,
- or directly putting it into your `custom_worlds` folder,
- or by dragging and dropping the apworld onto the Archipelago Launcher.

The Archipelago Launcher will need to be restarted if it was already open when the apworld was installed.

## Connecting to the Archipelago server
When connecting to a multiworld for the first time, a new game should be started. Save slots are bound to the first
multiworld seed and slot name they were connected to. To resume playing a multiworld at a later time, the same save slot
that initially connected to that multiworld should be loaded.

To connect to the multiworld server, run the **Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga Client** from the **Archipelago Launcher**
and connect it to the Archipelago server. Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga must be running before a connection can be
made.

The first time a save file connects to an Archipelago server, the slot name needs to be entered. After that, the slot
name will be set into the save data and read automatically from the save file by the client when connecting.

An in-game message will be displayed when the client is fully connected and running.

## Additional Setup for Linux
The client uses the `pymem` library, to read from/write to the game's memory, which only directly supports Windows,
therefore, additional setup is required to get the AP randomizer to work on Linux.

Follow the steps in [Flit's Linux Guide for Lego Star Wars TCS AP](https://gist.github.com/FlitPix/458ac9fb33610acc8bb3278ce071abca).
Ping `@flit` in the [Archipelago discord server's Linux & Steamdeck Setup thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/957390083193966612)
for additional assistance with the Linux setup.

readme.text:
# Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga Archipelago

This repository serves as a mirror of just the apworld source code and provides releases of the apworld.

Latest release:
https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-TCS/releases/latest

Setup guide:
https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-TCS/blob/main/lego_star_wars_tcs/docs/setup_en.md

Documentation:
https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-TCS/blob/main/lego_star_wars_tcs/docs/en_Lego%20Star%20Wars%20The%20Complete%20Saga.md

PopTracker pack:
https://github.com/Mysteryem/TCS_AP_PopTracker/releases/latest

The full source repository can be found at https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-ahit/tree/lsw_tcs

notes.text:
Almost a full rewrite of the APWorld's logic (just True Jedi logic that is unchanged).
- Each Minikit location has its own logic now, instead of before, where all Minikits in a chapter would only enter logic when you could reach all 10 in a chapter.
- Logic Difficulty options for different levels of skill/knowledge
  - None: Tries to match developer intended strategies, for players new to the game
  - Normal: No glitches expected, and Extras in logic, for players that have played most of the vanilla content
  - Moderate: Simpler glitches expected, for players that play the Archipelago randomizer often and are willing to learn simpler tricks
  - Hard: More difficult jumps and tricks, for players starting to learn speedrun tricks (installing *BrickBench* to assist in learning tricks is recommended)
  - Expert/Super Expert logic difficulties are planned, but are not being worked on at this time
- Exactly what tricks are expected by each Logic Difficulty are highly subject to change based on player feedback. Some tricks may be more difficult to understand while there are no videos explaining the tricks, so please take into consideration that videos of tricks are planned.

Minikit location names are highly subject to change (maybe a google form can be put together for the discord channel to suggest better names).

There is currently no PopTracker pack, and the client's Universal Tracker support does not include maps. The PopTracker pack is being worked on to support the v2.x.x APWorlds.

There is currently no document/videos detailing all the logic tricks in each difficulty. Most tricks have comments in the logic data for the corresponding Chapter/Bonus level https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-TCS/tree/main/lego_star_wars_tcs/data/logic (note that the `None` logic difficulty is referred to as the `base` logic internally and `er_rule`s are not used currently, but may contain relevant trick comments). If you would like to contribute videos of tricks, please upload them to YouTube.

# Known Issues
The pause screen text for showing goal progress does not get reset properly when closing the client, so the text can stack up if you open and close the client repeatedly

# Logic Rewrite
- Logic is rewritten to use Rule Builder and logical regions
- Minikits now have individual logic
- Four Logic Difficulty options for different player skill/knowledge
- Uncap OT High Jump option considered by logic

# Client
- /toggle_windowed command allows for playing in a window without DxWnd
- Debug commands to peek at game memory
- APWorld version now shown in the client description and window title
- Customised Death Link death messages
- Active Extras are written into save data and restored by the client
- Replaced some of the fake items names with even faker sounding names

# New Options
- Logic Difficulty
- Logic option for whether 2-1 expects progressing with pod racers
- Non-vehicle Max Health
- Vehicle Max Health
- Random options for Goal Chapter

# Universal Tracker support
- `/explain` support for rules
- Deferred events support
- Glitched logic shows +1 logic difficulty by default
- `/ut_toggle_all_glitches` shows the highest logic difficulty. If using the standalone Universal Tracker client, this command is not available, but you can `/manually_collect UT_GLITCHED_ALL` instead

# Changes
- Anakin's Flight and A New Hope are now played in Free Play mode
- Attempting to play a level in Story mode that should be played in Free Play kicks the player back to the Cantina now, instead of just warning them
- No Minikit items in the item pool if the minikit goal is disabled
- Removed Luke Skywalker (Dagobah) being able to complete Dagobah (logic accounts for this now)
- Removed Yoda/Yoda (Ghost) getting a speed increase at the start of 3-6 (logic accounts for this now)

# Fixes
- Fix Yoda/Yoda (Ghost) being able to perform glitchy wall jumps
- Fix Yoda logically being able to wear hats
- Fix the client thinking you're not playing when shadows are off
- Fix slot name/seed name clobbering Challenge mode timer data

# Internal
- Slot data handling entirely rewritten and much easier to update now
- Most use of string literals replaced with StrEnum/IntEnum
- Added some generation tests
- Add future-proofing check that the seed name is not too long
- Add check that the slot name does not encode to too many bytes
- Refactored __init__.py to be smaller, extract code elsewhere
- Bumped minimum AP version to 0.6.8
